items.title: A surjective endomorphism of a Noetherian ring is an isomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that a surjective endomorphism of a Noetherian ring is automatically injective and therefore an isomorphism (statement lines 6435-6438). The proof does not use the module-theoretic statement that a surjective endomorphism of a finitely generated module is injective, nor Nakayama: it assumes a nonzero kernel and exhibits the chain of iterated kernels of f, which strictly increases, as a contradiction to the ascending chain condition (proof lines 6440-6447). The observation that a non-injective endomorphism has strictly growing iterated kernels is the step carrying the content, and the author writes the chain out explicitly. H2.
